changelog: Strengthened [Never Segment] with two narrow, absolute prohibitions: never split a numeric quantity from its unit, and never separate the first conjunct from its coordinating conjunction in paired 'between/either' style constructions. These are always harmful and safe to forbid.

Added a short post-marking local safety check in [Decision Procedure] that demotes (lowers confidence for) boundaries matching high-risk surface patterns (number+unit separation, 'between' first-conjunct splits, and boundaries immediately before colon-introduced lists), so risky candidates remain allowed but are ranked lower without removing other options.

Added one Segment example demonstrating safe handling of 'between A and B' (do not cut the first conjunct alone) and added one Do NOT Segment example showing numeric quantity+unit should not be split. These clarify the new absolute rules.
